sourceInspection.nonSubstitutionRule: A manifest type name, generic Ontology list, Action runtime or historical upstream projection does not constitute OperationCase authority or current Workshop readiness.

frozenAuthorityDecision.originalFacts: L0/O1 events and commerce objects remain immutable upstream authority and are referenced by exact scoped refs/hash; no transaction payload copy.
frozenAuthorityDecision.classification: OperationEventClassificationDecisionRevision is append-only and records classifier/policy/evidence refs, confidence, actor and reason without mutating the original event.
frozenAuthorityDecision.aggregationPolicy: AggregationPolicyRevision is append-only policy authority; it never becomes the original-event authority.
frozenAuthorityDecision.operationCase: OperationCase is a tenant-scoped event-sourced L1 aggregate authority whose membership and status are rebuilt from exact originals and append-only decisions/events.
frozenAuthorityDecision.projection: Case list/timeline/SLA summaries are rebuildable projections and may be deleted/rebuilt without deleting originals or decisions.
frozenAuthorityDecision.sla: SLA deadlines and breach state are derived from an exact SlaPolicyRevision, case event time and pause/resume decisions; wall-clock display state is not authority.
frozenAuthorityDecision.kill: Automation kill is an append-only policy/decision ref checked immediately before lease/acquisition and execution; it blocks new effects but never rewrites prior attempts or receipts.

requiredInvariants: Provider event/ref/hash replay is idempotent and duplicate or out-of-order input never duplicates actions.
Every Case member remains reachable to an original event/object and membership count reconciles after split/merge.
Policy revision change produces a new rebuild result and explicit migration/review decision; it does not silently rewrite current membership.
Split and merge append successor decisions and preserve predecessor Case timelines and receipts.
SLA policy drift marks readiness stale and recomputation is auditable.
Kill decision blocks new proposal/lease/execution according to policy while in-flight/unknown outcomes remain visible for reconcile.
Money, address and customer data follow purpose/marking/minimum-disclosure rules and never enter logs or Receipt plaintext.
